Experience the thrill of jetting across the largest riding area on the East Coast, making every moment on the waves unforgettable. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Experience the ultimate Outer Banks adventure with our premier boat rentals on Hatteras Island. From versatile pontoons to nimble Carolina Skiffs and the unique charm of our Tiki Boats, we offer a diverse fleet to suit every explorer’s taste. Cruise the pristine waters of the Pamlico Sound in style, surrounded by the natural beauty of the TriVillage area. Our rentals include top-notch equipment and a variety of choices, ensuring an unforgettable maritime journey. blurb: Guests rent boats, jet skis, pontoons, skiffs, and tiki boats to explore the Pamlico Sound at their own pace. The equipment is top-quality and includes all essentials for a safe and enjoyable experience. The operation is known for friendly staff and competitive rates.

quotes.author: Penny C., Tripadvisor
quotes.text: This is a top notch operation. Looking to get out on the water in the OBX, call Charlie's. Reservations are a good idea. The fleet was worn but serviceable. The folks were great and their rates are the lowest we found. Worth the trip.

quotes.author: Chelsea D., Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Great people and great jet skis! We got there and they put us in a ski in a matter of 10 minutes. Of course call ahead if you have a big party. Worth the prices!

quotes.author: Clover L., Tripadvisor
quotes.text: We had a great outing on the Pamlico Sound with the hard top pontoon. Easy to drive, able to fit coolers, fishing gear and 16 people. It was fabulous!

quotes.author: Audrey F., Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Very nice and knowledgeable staff. Very friendly and an overall great experience. Would definitely use them again.
